{{Quote|Dumb Arconan bet me five big ones that the tinhead is gonna come up roses. Against a Holwuff! Like anyone can win against one of those.|A bar patron on Nurosenti|<ref name="Tempest Runner">''[[The High Republic: Tempest Runner]]''</ref>}}
The '''Holwuff'''<ref name="Tempest Runner" /> were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="AOTC" /> One, [[Rogwa Wodrata]] was a senator.

==History==
Holwuffs were present within the wider galaxy by [[252 BBY]]<ref name="TRDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Tempest Runner]]'' to [[231 BBY]] and also establishes that [[Asgar Ro]] became [[Eye of the Nihil]] in [[252 BBY]]. [[The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 1|''The High Republic: Eye of the Storm'' 1]] depicts [[Lourna Dee]] as a member of the [[Nihil]] at this point. As ''Tempest Runner'' establishes that Dee joined the Nihil after the [[raid in the Abrion sector]], the raid must have taken place by 252 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. The audio drama further states that the [[Holwuff]] was [[Death|killed]] on [[Nurasenti]] before the [[Abrion sector]] raid, therefore meaning he must passed away by that [[Standard year|year]].</ref>  Holwuffs had a strong reputation as formidable fighters. Some were even designated "Holwuff berserkers"<ref name="Tempest Runner" /> At least one Holwuff was elected senator.<ref name="OF 84" />

==Biology and appearance==
Holwuff had a large, broad head. Their skin was gray-brown and deep folds and wrinkles covered the face, especially around their short, wide snouts. Two large nostrils sat at the front of their snouts. The eyes were small, dark, and set deep under a thick brow ridge. The mouth was a wide horizontal slit. Two short, yellowed tusks curved upward from the lower jaw. Short gray [[hair|hairs]] grew along the top ridge and lower face.<ref name="AOTC" />

The being had large, broad hands with four fingers, including what an opposable thumb positioned lower on the hand tapered to blunt tips with pale, flat nails.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Holwuff in the galaxy==
[[File:Rogwa wodrata.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rogwa Wodrata, a Holwuff senator who conspired with the CIS.]]

By 252 BBY<ref name="TRDate" />in a bar owned by [[Karter]] near a [[Nurasenti]] spaceport, a [[Unidentified Holwuff berserker|Holwuff]] described as a “Holwuff berserker” engaged in a violent brawl with [[Lourna Dee]], an armored [[Twi'lek]] [[Gender|female]] wearing battered [[Mandalorian]]-style armor. Patrons placed [[gambling|bets]] on the fight, with one customer on a [[comlink]] to [[Korval]] asserting that no one could defeat a Holwuff and wagering five [[Galactic Credit Standard|ingots]] on it, while an [[Arcona]] patron named [[Sneef]] wagered five ingots on the armored fighter. After the Holwuff was killed by four point-blank [[blaster]] shots, Sneef won the bet and suggested settling it with a bottle of Mind Eraser bought by the losing customer, only for the victorious armored Lourna Dee to approach Sneef, confirm his winnings, and take the bottle after a mild protest from him, which he withdrew when challenged.<ref name="Tempest Runner" />

One Holwuff, [[Senator]] [[Rogwa Wodrata]], supported the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis]],<ref name="OF 84">{{GermanFanCite|84|Database}}</ref> attending a [[Geonosian accord|summit]] on [[Geonosis]] where the [[Executive Separatist Council]] pledged loyalty to [[Count]] [[Dooku]] just before the beginning of the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Holwuff were first developed as the species for the character of Rogwa Wodrata in [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], directed by [[George Lucas]]. Rogwa Wodrata was created to replace the character [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] in the [[2002]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Insider65">{{InsiderCite|65|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref><ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> Toora was originally present during filming of the Separatist council scene,<ref name="SWCTP" /><ref name="Insider65" /> She was practical alien originally built for the Senate scenes in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace]], was present during filming of ''Attack of the Clones''<ref name="SWCTP" /> but during post-production, director [[George Lucas]] was unsatisfied with the lack of expression or menace in her mask and decided to replace her with Wodrata.<ref>{{SWArchive|url=qa|text=''Star Wars'' Q & A}} - Episode II Lore - February 07, 2003</ref><ref name="Insider65" /><ref name="SWCTP" /><ref name="Insider101">{{InsiderCite|101|Ask Lobot}}</ref> According to the website Avleyman the character was played by [[Hilton Howson]].<ref name="Aveleyman">{{WebCite|url=https://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=76971|text=Aveleyman – Hilton Howson|work=[http://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman.com]|archivedate=20181105143534}}</ref> Rogwa's head, nicknamed 'Gatorhead' by [[Industrial Light & Magic]] was a retooled alien Jedi design that was composited over Toonbuck Toora.<ref name="SWCTP" /><ref name="Insider65" />

The Holwuff species made another canonical appearance in the form of Senator Rogwa Wodrata, who was visible during a retelling of the events depicted in ''Attack of the Clones'' within the story [[This is Obi-Wan]].<ref name="Galactic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: Meet the Galactic Heroes]]''</ref>
